entities.summary: Duke Charles Louis Frederick of Mecklenburg-Strelitz was a member of the Strelitz branch of the House of Mecklenburg. He was the father of Queen Charlotte of the United Kingdom and Hanover and Duke Adolphus Frederick IV of Mecklenburg-Strelitz.
